sourceNote: Ministry of Justice (법무부) press release, 2026-07-07: '연봉 1억 문턱은 낮추고 체류기간은 최대 3년으로…'. URL verified live 2026-08-18. Clarifications (decline and watch areas qualify inside the capital area; gross income; exchange rate on the application day): Ministry of Justice reply to e-People inquiry 1AA-2608-1171435, 2026-10-15, kept at /assets/docs/moj-clarification-1aa-2608-1171435.pdf.
disclaimer: General guidance only, based on the Ministry of Justice's F‑1‑D (Digital Nomad / Workation) visa announcement. Rules and thresholds are revised periodically — always confirm current requirements with the Ministry of Justice or your nearest Korean embassy or consulate before applying.
thresholdsByMultiplierNote: The 3 distinct threshold figures (copied verbatim from the Ministry of Justice release at sourceUrl: 5,241만원/7,862만원/10,483만원), keyed by multiplier so each is stored exactly once — every ageBand/familyMultiplier below just names which multiplier applies. Not derived by multiplying gniPerCapitaKrw: that doesn't reproduce MOJ's published figures, since they were computed from the unrounded GNI.

additionalFacts.minApplicantAgeExemption: Accompanying minor children are exempt from the age-18 minimum
additionalFacts.workRestriction: No local paid employment or for-profit activity permitted
additionalFacts.eligibleApplicantSummary: Employed by an overseas company in a remote-work-capable role, with at least 1 year in the same job/industry; accompanying spouse and minor children may join
additionalFacts.nonCapitalDefinitionNote: "Non-capital area" for visa purposes includes areas officially designated as population-decrease (인구감소관심지역), even when they sit administratively inside a capital-tier province — see populationDeclineAreas.json.
